text:
Samira: Clearing stuff out from my desk next week. Free to good home: Herman Miller Sayl chair (black, adjustable arms, solid foam seat) and 2x 24" Dell monitors (DVI + DP, stands included). Also have 2x day passes to Moscone exhibit hall for Tues (unused). Pick up from SOMA office by Tue evening. Pics: https://imgur.com/sayl24

Devon: Interested in the monitors if they're still around. Stand height adjust?

Samira: Yes stands tilt and height-adjust ~13cm. Monitors are model P2417H, no dead pixels.

Rory: Id love the Sayl chair if its still available. Can pick up Mon or Tue morning.

Nia: Two day passes—are they tied to a registration name or physical barcode?

Samira: Passes are printable PDFs with barcodes, I can email/print and leave at front desk. Not name-locked.

FacilitiesBot: Reminder: bulky-item pickups require freight elevator booking and a facilities escort after 6pm. See #eng-infra for reservations.

Devon: Can pick up the monitors Mon 6pm. DMing you now Samira for cell number.

Rory: I can do Mon 9:30am pickup and will bring a dolly. If Samira wants, label it "For Rory" and I'll collect.

Samira: Will label the chair and monitors. Putting monitors in locker G and chair disassembled by the back stairwell with screws taped in a zip bag labeled. Day passes I'll leave at front desk in envelope "Devon/Rory" until claimed.

Nia: If any of the items remain after Tuesday, happy to take the chair base or passes.

Devon: Claimed monitors, thanks Samira! :raised_hands: 

Rory: Claimed the chair. DM received re: dolly. Thanks!

Samira: Youre welcome both. If plans change I'll update here. Enjoy!

(Reaction: Samira's first message got :sparkles: from Rory)
